image_description: Two black professional audio loudspeakers positioned side-by-side against a white background. The speaker on the right is angled to show its front face, featuring a large central woofer cone and a smaller tweeter at the top, both protected by a perforated metal grille. The speaker on the left shows its side profile and partial front, revealing a similar grille pattern and branding text 'MACKIE' near the bottom. Both units have a boxy, rectangular enclosure shape typical of stage monitors or PA speakers.
